digest.component_or_area: config-ownership AST gate and approved-owner registry
propositions: An AST gate must detect and prohibit ambient env reads, helper-shim env reads, load_config calls, literal-getattr env equivalents, provider-credential reads, and configurable adapter defaults outside approved seam boundaries
The gate must reuse gen_env_registry.py's env-read detection and helper-shim resolution (KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS) as a single authoritative source, failing closed on unresolved or dynamic env reads

Approved seams comprise composition roots (config.py, _config_sources.py, _child_env.py, anthropic_model.py, bedrock_model.py) and provider-credential boundaries (four runtime.py/access_check.py/settings.py/acli_subprocess.py paths), with owner sets derived from existing registries rather than hand-copied
The gate must resolve callee and receiver aliases (import-as, local assignment) to detect direct, imported, and locally-aliased call forms, including receiver-object aliasing of os.environ
A legacy-exception set enumerates current below-seam reads to allow non-disruptive introduction; a drift self-test flags newly declared env spellings or credential names lacking an owner
The gate exposes check(root)->list[str] and main(argv)->int contracts, runs offline with no network dependency, and exits 0 on the current tree
